description: Niagara's Channels feature registers a diagnostic tip whose message is a giant fingerprint of concatenated hashCode() integers of up to 30 channel items (~850 digits). Because the provider accepts every tip request, this shows up as a tile of giant numbers on the home feed whenever the channel list refreshes, which happens when apps are installed, updated or removed (for example through ADB). Makes the provider decline tip requests so the diagnostic tip is never shown.
name: Fix home screen numbers tile

description: Disables all telemetry in Niagara Launcher: the weekly usage-report upload (app launches, notification metadata, survey responses), retention milestone events, GDPR consent sync, Singular attribution sessions and events (advertising ID, app set ID, install referrer, FCM token) and the runtime Firebase Analytics opt-in.
name: Remove analytics

description: Makes isPremium() always return true in AI Audio Novel Reader. Unlocks all premium features and disables the 10-hour trial countdown.
name: Unlock premium

description: Makes the entitlement holder always report Pro in Niagara Launcher. Unlocks all Pro features and bypasses the 7-day trial prompt. Server-backed features (account sync, Stripe checkout) are not affected.
name: Unlock Pro

description: Stops Facebook watching for screenshots of ads and reporting which apps you install for ad attribution.
name: [Ad] Block ad telemetry

description: Stops Facebook downloading ads and its ad model in the background, which saves data, battery and storage.
name: [Ad] Block background ad prefetch

description: Stops Facebook serving ads to other apps. Those apps then show their own ads or none, and rewarded ads can fail.
name: [Ad] Disable Audience Network

description: Hides LINE display ads: the LINE Ads banners, the Smart Channel banner in the chat list and Google AdManager ads.
name: [Ad] Hide ad views

description: LINE no longer loads the Smart Channel banner ads. This patch makes the getBanners and getPrefetchableBanners responses null.
name: [Ad] Remove banner ads

description: Removes the AI Friends button from the Chats tab header. The Album button shows in its place.

description: Removes the server-provided tools (Poll, Schedule and more) from the + menu in a chat. Built-in tiles stay.

description: Removes the community (OpenChat) button from the top of the Chats tab header.

description: Hides the "CHECK" tips under some messages, such as a received video.

description: When you open a chat, LINE does not mark it read or send a read receipt. "Mark as read" still works.

description: Removes the Agent i button from the Home header and from the search bar.
